tei:div.tei:p: thams cad mkhyen pa spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas ni/ yongs su grags pa'i 'bri gung spyan snga rnam gnyis las/ de yang bod mi'u gdung drug ces pa'i ya gyal se khyung dbra las mched pa lha gzigs rlangs kyi gdung rgyud las byung zhing*/ mi lo bco brgyad ring 'bri gung skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon spyan sngar 'bral med bzhugs te chos dang zhabs 'bring gnyis ka bskyangs pas 'bri gung spyan snga ba zhes yongs su grags/ chos srid gnyis kar mkhyen rgya che bas dgung lo so drug thog khri thon por bshams te/ (de nas chos rje'i gsung gis/ kha rtsang phar bcad khyed nga'i bu yin slob ma yin/ de ring nas nga'i bla ma yin/ pha yin gsungs nas chos rje nyid kyis phyag phul/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur/ mtshams bcad pa brgya dang rtsa brgyad dang bcas pa brdzangs nas gdan sa 'dir tshogs pa lo nyi shu rtsa drug gi bar du bskyangs )ces rlangs kyi po ti bse ru rgyas pa las gsungs shing*/ de rjes kyang dpal phag gru'i gdan sa thel de nyid rje nyid kyi gdung rabs rlangs kyi brgyud pa rim byon gyis bskyangs nas de dag kyang gangs can ljongs su chos srid gnyis la mdzad rjes rlabs po che bskyangs pa'i lo rgyus mang*/ de rjes slar yang 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi gdan rabs bzhi pa'i khur 'dzin bskyangs skabs gdan sa khyon lo nyer gcig mdzad/ de'i ring la phag gru gdan sa thel dang*/ 'bri gung gdan sa thel yas mas gnyis ka'i bstan pa gra rgyas phun sum tshogs pa byung*/ dpal sa skya'i rje btsun chen po grags pa 'byung gnas gshegs rdzongs kyi gral dbur chos rje 'bri gung spyan snga gdan 'dren zhu bar/ 'gro mgon sa skya paṇḍi ta'i spyan 'dren zhu yig tu (dpal ldan chos kyi rje chen po/ 'gro ba rnams kyi bla ma/ 'gran zla med pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ gcig tu bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i khur khyer bas bstan pa la de nyid gnyis par gyur pa/

brtse ba'i ma ma dam pa thugs kyi phrin las gzhol bas lus can rnams la phan pa dang*/ bde ba sbyin pa'i rtsa lag chen po/ gangs kyi ri bo'i spor yongs su rdzogs pa'i bsil zer can gyi 'od zer 'phros pas shin tu ches gsal ba'i phun sum tshogs pa ltar dpal kun tu lam me ba/ padma dam pa'i ge sar g.yo ba'i rdul gyi dris kun nas bsdus pa'i bung ba'i phreng ba dar dir gyi sgra sgrog pas khyab pa'i chu gter chen po ltar/ yon tan gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa'i 'byung khungs/ skye dgu'i sgron me dpal kun tu 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi snang ba shar gyi ri bo'i rtser mngon du shar ba ltar gdul bya'i padma rnam par 'byed cing*/ mi shes pa'i rab rib rnam par sel ba/ nag po'i rtsal gyi rgyu skar zil gyis gnon pa'i ye shes kyi nyi ma chen po/ bskal pa dpag tu med par bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsgrubs pas/ yon tan gyi khyad par mngon du mdzad nas/ lhar bcar 'jig rten gyi rnam par 'dren pa chen por gyur pa dpal chos rje rin po che'i blar/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab kyi snang bas blo gros kyi me tog cung zad kha bye ba/ shākya'i dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bgyi bas chab shog gi yi ge phul ba/) zhes dang*/ (bdag cag bka' drin gyi lan/ mchod pa chos lugs dang mthun pa zhig bgyi bar 'tshal/ de la mchod pa'i yul lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ rin po che kho na mchog tu gyur par mthong nas/ dpal sa skya'i dben gnas su spyan 'dren par 'tshal bas/ thugs rin po che la gdags par zhu/ spyir rin po che pa spyan 'dren pa 'di phyogs mtha' dag nas spobs pa shin tu dka' yang*/ rgyu mtshan gcig tu na ning snga ma'i bka' yig la/ 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes pa yin pa dang*/ rgyu mtshan gnyis par/ rin po che rnyed pa dang bkur bsti la mi gzigs shing*/

sems can gyi don la dgongs pa yin pa dang*/ gsum pa/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i ngo bor gyur pa'i rje btsun sa skya ba chen po'i gdan sa yin la/) zhes rlangs kyi po ti bse ru ldeb 142 su gsal ba sogs rnam thar rgyas pa zur du bzhugs yod/ spyir thams cad mkhyen pa spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas kyi gsung 'bum ji snyed cig bzhugs rung dus dbang gis rkyen pas thor bu pod gcig las lag son ma gyur stabs 'di lam khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thub dbang ratna shrī'i bka' 'bum mjug tu bu chos zhes mnyam du par bskrun bgyis pa 'dis kyang dge rtsa phyogs med du gyur pa'i smon 'dun bcas/ rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i mtshan gyis byin gyis brlabs pa dkon mchog bstan 'dzin kun bzang phrin las lhun grub pas spyi lo 2001 zla 9 tshes bzang por// //
